connector.name: techmanual.ai
connector.registryDescription: Search technical manuals for T&M, industrial automation, and power electronics equipment.
connector.summary: Hosted at mcp.techmanual.ai over streamable HTTP, also runs locally from the Python package techmanual-client. Needs a bearer token header, and it reaches all 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the techmanual-ai account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A bearer token is sent in a request header. Store it outside the config file wherever your client supports it.
